sources.title: Kenneth Dike Library guide, 2023
sources.source_date: 2023 from official path and filename; index publication date not relied on
sources.finding: Guide page24 publishes http://ils.library.ui.edu.ng for access outside the library. It also lists private 10.0.43.3:8080; the private address was not requested. The guide states author, title, subject and keyword OPAC searches.

sources.title: SWIB18 programme, November2018
sources.finding: UIILS developers describe a staff-facing local LCSH lookup using Library of Congress data and Apache Jena/Fuseki. This is classification metadata tooling, not a published public Ibadan holdings/search API.
Google Play URL surfaced through third-party indexes of university-authored KDLUI app. Web tool could not access it; no alternate catalog endpoint or book search recovered.
Secondary web tool normalized to HTTPS and returned inaccessible, independently of direct environment HTTP diagnostic. No real record or search result was returned.

Discovery-only: page advertises broad coverage but visible member section included zero-entry institutions and a demo. No University of Ibadan member/holdings evidence recovered. Excluded from catalog verification.
